content: Discussed Q3 AI rollout. Team concerned about adoption rates. Need training plan by Friday. Budget approved for 50 licences.
User cannot access the AI writing tool. Has tried logging out and back in. Issue started Monday morning after the update.
Leadership want ROI report on AI tools by end of month. Need to pull usage data and interview department heads.
Team asking if AI tool can integrate with Salesforce. Current workflow requires manual copy paste between systems.
Workshop feedback positive. 8 out of 10 employees felt more confident using AI after session. Two requested follow up on prompt writing.
